sentences: You open an old file, and the editor already flags what is wrong with it: two imports nobody uses, and code that looks a bit rushed.
Jump straight to the next problem. No scrolling, no scanning the file line by line.
Ask for a fix. Ruff offers to remove the import, and one key applies it.
Same for the second one. Jump, fix, done.
The name legacy total says nothing. Rename it through the language server, so every place that uses it changes too, not just this line.
And the squeezed spacing? One key formats the whole file.
Two warnings gone, a better name and a clean file, in a few seconds, without reaching for the mouse.

cards.label: Chapter 4 · Fixing warnings
cards.title: Clean up an old file in seconds
cards.problem: Unused imports, a vague name and squeezed spacing. Fix all of it without hunting for each one.
cards.before: Find each squiggle in the file, open the light bulb menu, pick the fix, then press F2 to rename and run the formatter from the menu.
cards.after: ] d jumps to the next problem, Space c a fixes it, Space r n renames, Space F formats. Same keys in every file.
